reviews.title: Incredible speed with excellent cooling
reviews.comment: This Samsung 9100 PRO SSD is absolutely blazing fast! The read speeds up to 14,700 MB/s are phenomenal - my system boots in seconds and large files transfer instantly. The included heatsink keeps temperatures perfectly stable even during intensive workloads. Installation was straightforward with clear instructions. The PCIe 5.0x4 interface delivers incredible performance that's noticeable in everything from gaming to video editing. The build quality is excellent - feels very premium and well-constructed. The 2TB capacity provides plenty of storage for games and projects. Samsung's reputation for reliability gives me confidence in longevity. This is an outstanding investment for anyone building a high-performance PC. Best SSD I've ever used!
reviews.author: Ruslan

reviews.title: Amazing for PS5pro!!!
reviews.comment: Glad I waited on an SSD expansion for the PS5 pro. This drive is so blindingly fast! I had to buy shades. Haha! It transferred 1.2 TB of data in about 4 minutes from the PS5Pro host drive. The 2TB price was only $10 more than the previous 990 version for 2025 black Friday. But the 9100 model is twice as fast, runs cooler and uses less power. Win-win-win. Although it's overspec'd for PS5, it is backward compatible. So more is better IMHO. Since it specs way above PS5pro requirements, I'm all ready for PS6!! Super easy install, but be sure and watch MULTIPLE videos if you haven't done this before. There's about 8 steps to the process including tips n tricks. For instance, PS5pro opens from BOTTOM for this storage expansion. Every video I watch seemed to leave out one or two or three aspects of this procedure. By watching multiple videos you'll get ALL of the information you need not just part of it. - I will update if there is any issue with longevity. Would definitely buy again.
reviews.author: Krylos

reviews.title: Yoo, this thing is fire. Price now for the heatsink, though. Noooo.
reviews.comment: It's stable and easy to install in a desktop computer. Never think it will fit in some laptops because it probably will not, and you can't remove the heatsink or you'll void the warranty per the sticker. It's well built, like most Samsung products—lol. Its heatsink has some weight to it, and the material feels heavy-duty. Its storage capacity is enough—2TB—but at this point, the price is a sharp no. I got this thing when it was around $480 because I saw it jump from about $450, but now it's $700. Consider that these things were just about $180 a few months ago. Look, this isn't about the drive itself—take into consideration that they haven't gotten any better; they're just more scarce. So, the real advice I can give you is to buy any PC-related components you can now because you might not be able to later. The "build a PC" and "upgrade your stuff" game is about to die. Anyway. Drive rocks if you can afford it yahooooo
reviews.author: Brad

reviews.title: Go Big
reviews.comment: If you are new to building PCs triple check you have enough space. Taking off the heat sink voids the warranty so you would be better off returning it and buying a non-heat sink. For the power it gives, the temps are great. 8TB you don’t have to break a sweat on storage and for AI it helps load models faster which is nice. Installation was easy IF you have a screw. To the newbies seeing this like myself: the knob is not the screw, it’s the spacer. Most PCs don’t come with the screw you’ll likely need. I got the 8TB for $750 on Black Friday which felt like a big win. Let’s see how this ages in cost.
reviews.author: Day Man

reviews.title: Best SSD Quality
reviews.comment: Samsung SSDs are tried and true. Ive never had a pro version Samsung SSD ever fail. The 9100 pro works perfectly although it does run hot. The heatsink does it's job.
